_about: Source of truth for every photo and video on the site. Put originals in assets/source/<category>/<id>.<jpg|png|webp|avif|tif>, then run `npm run images`. An image is only publishable when rights.status is "cleared".

images.alt: Sunrise over the Tirumala hills, with mist in the valleys and the temple among the trees
images.sourcing: licensed-photo preferred; AI-generated acceptable only if no specific temple is depicted
images.prompt: Cinematic, photorealistic wide landscape photograph of the Tirumala hills (Seshachalam range, Andhra Pradesh) at golden sunrise, layered forested ridges, atmospheric morning mist in the valleys, warm gold light from the right, premium tourism campaign photography, calm and reverent mood, large area of soft sky and mist on the left third for headline text, no buildings in close-up, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark, 16:9.

images.alt: Sunrise over the Tirumala hills, with mist in the valleys and the temple among the trees

images.prompt: Vertical, photorealistic tourism photograph of the lush Tirumala hills at sunrise, a winding ghat road disappearing into soft mist, warm golden light, premium travel photography, upper third mostly clear sky for a headline, lower third darker for buttons, no people, no text, no watermark, 9:16.

images.alt: Raja gopuram of Sri Govindaraja Swamy Temple in Tirupati town
images.prompt: Reference brief for a photographer/stock search: exterior of a Tirupati town temple (e.g. Sri Govindaraja Swamy or Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple), gopuram fully in frame, natural daylight, devotees at a respectful distance, editorial travel style, no text or watermark.
images.notes: Confirm the exact temple shown and update the alt text to match it.
